title: Total world container ship fleet capacity, 1990 vs 2022

source.name: Evolution of container shipping fleet capacity
source.publisher: Port Economics, Management and Policy / Sinay

notes: In 1990 the global container ship fleet (1,169 vessels) carried about 1.2 million TEU total. By mid-2022, 6,406 container ships carried about 25.8 million TEU total.
